record.paper_title: Homogeneous manifolds whose geodesics are orbits. Recent results and some open problems
record.original_question: For a fixed Riemannian homogeneous space M=G/K and a fixed connected transitive isometry group G, determine all G-invariant Riemannian metrics g for which (M=G/K,g) is a G-g.o. space. In this setting, G-g.o. means that every geodesic is an orbit gamma(t)=exp(tX).o of a one-parameter subgroup of G. Can the classification of all such metrics be carried out for arbitrary homogeneous spaces rather than only for known families?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $M = G/K$ be a Riemannian homogeneous space, where $G$ is a connected Lie group acting transitively and effectively by isometries on $M$ and $K$ is the isotropy subgroup at a base point $o \in M$. A $G$-invariant Riemannian metric $g$ on $M$ is called a $G$-geodesic orbit metric (or $G$-g.o. metric) if every geodesic of $(M,g)$ is the orbit of a one-parameter subgroup of $G$; that is, for every geodesic $\gamma$ there exists $X$ in the Lie algebra $\mathfrak{g}$ of $G$ such that $\gamma(t) = \exp(tX)\cdot o$ for all $t \in \mathbb{R}$. The space $(M=G/K,g)$ is then called a $G$-g.o. space.

Problem: For an arbitrary Riemannian homogeneous space $M = G/K$ with $G$ a fixed connected transitive isometry group, determine explicitly the set of all $G$-invariant Riemannian metrics $g$ on $M$ such that $(M=G/K, g)$ is a $G$-g.o. space. In particular, produce a classification of all $G$-g.o. metrics that is valid for arbitrary homogeneous spaces $G/K$, rather than only within specific families (such as compact simple Lie groups, generalized flag manifolds, Stiefel manifolds, nilmanifolds, or other previously studied classes).
artifact.category_tag: Geodesic orbit metrics on homogeneous spaces
artifact.status_search_result: Multiple recent surveys and research papers (2021–2026) confirm that the complete classification of Riemannian geodesic orbit manifolds remains a longstanding open problem. Only partial classifications exist for specific families, such as compact simple Lie groups, generalized flag manifolds, Stiefel manifolds, nilmanifolds, and low dimensions (≤ 6, by Kowalski–Vanhecke).

status_evidence.title: A review of compact geodesic orbit manifolds and the g.o. condition for SU(5)/S(U(2)×U(2))
status_evidence.snippet: Despite the several known classes of g.o. manifolds... the classification of g.o. manifolds remains an open problem, even within the class of compact simple Lie groups, where only partial classifications have been produced up to this day.
status_evidence.claim: Classification of g.o. manifolds is open, with only partial results for specific classes.

status_evidence.title: Homogeneous spaces with geodesic orbit Riemannian metrics and with integrable invariant distributions
status_evidence.snippet: While most of the aforementioned classes have been completely determined, the complete classification of Riemannian g.o. manifolds remains a longstanding open problem.
status_evidence.claim: Complete classification of Riemannian g.o. manifolds is a longstanding open problem.
